description: Annotated compilation graphic pairing a Downdetector-style Xbox Live outage status page (137 reports, spike chart, U.S. outage heat map, recent-outage history) with screenshots of two Q posts from Aug 15-16, 2018. Red and green annotations circle the Aug 15 outage spike and Q's mention of 'PS/Xbox chat logs', claiming the Xbox Live outage occurred just after the Q post and asking whether it is coincidence. The image presents this correlation as the creator's claim.

description: Photograph of Donald Trump's presidential inauguration, January 20, 2017, captioned 'WE ARE Q!' in large red letters. The view looks from the U.S. Capitol's west front platform down a blue-carpeted aisle toward the crowd filling the National Mall; Trump is seen from behind walking out to the podium as dignitaries stand and applaud. The caption appropriates the inauguration image as a QAnon slogan.

Photograph of a cast-metal Nazi-era Reichsadler emblem: an eagle with outstretched wings perched on a wreath containing a swastika. The original filename 'IronEagle.jpg' ties it to the recurring Q phrase 'Iron Eagle'. Shown as a historical object against a plain background.
flags: Contains a Nazi symbol (swastika); documented here as an archived historical reference, not endorsement

description: Side-by-side comparison meme of two antifascist logos: the red Antifaschistische Aktion emblem with two red flags, captioned '1933 Paramilitary Wing of the Communist Party of Germany', and the modern black-and-red Antifascist Action emblem, captioned '2017 Paramilitary Wing of the Democratic Party of America'. The meme claims the modern Antifa movement is the paramilitary wing of the U.S. Democratic Party.
